About Us

AXA worldwide

A global insurance leader

At AXA, our mission to "Protect what matters" is embodied by our 156,000 employees and agents around the world. Every day, we provide innovative solutions in the Group's property and casualty, health, life, savings and retirement businesses. Our goal? To help our customers manage risk, improve their care, preserve their wealth, and respond effectively to their specific needs.
